name: manual_665bf3
claim: A staged private-range address gate must extract a complete address token and validate it with ipaddress. A partial IPv6 grammar plus a trailing word-or-colon boundary misses port-suffixed IPv4 and compressed unique-local addresses.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review 5324084599 comment 4109787018 on Perpetua-Tools PR 399 commit ff26c2845afabb8d5f7b3bc4c5a273005262d9cc. Fixed in 0037cbe4bd5e8ba971464790fedec5e42341cbbc and synced to orama-system. Parse the whole token first; strip a trailing colon-port only when ipaddress rejects it.
